rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); SkiaSurface::read_current_rgba() now judges the Graphite InsertStatus of its mid-frame flush the same way end_frame() already does, so a rejected recording fails the capture and leaves the frame unsubmitted, and wait_for_submitted_work() returns the synchronizing submit's result instead of a constant true. A process-wide insert-outcome test seam is added beside them. No frame, present, readback-format, design-import, Chromium, packaging or authority boundary moves; the Pulp render target has not adopted a Vellum package.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SkiaSurface readback fails when Graphite rejects the flushed recording'
